marks.gloss_en: השתא דשמעתינהו להני שמעתתא -- Rav Huna's ruling
השתא דשמעתינהו להני שמעתתא -- Rav Nachman's ruling
השתא דשמעתינהו להני שמעתתא -- Rav Chisda's ruling
Rava, now that he heard these rulings: visual recognition is better
דאי לא תימא הכי, היאך סומא מותר באשתו... אלא בטביעות עינא דקלא, הכא נמי בטביעות עינא
Rava: how is a blind man permitted his wife, and men their wives at night? -- by recognition of the voice
תדע -- witnesses identifying by marks do not suffice for execution; by recognition they do
Rav Yitzchak brei deRav Mesharshya: two witnesses who identify a killer by marks -- we do not execute him; by visual recognition -- we execute him
תדע -- an agent sent by marks may not know the man; by recognition he does
Rav Ashi: an agent sent to call someone by his marks may or may not know him; by visual recognition, he knows him when he sees him
שנאמר: על כף הירך -- Shmuel's own derivation of his dictum (svara stands in for a derivation-grade support kind)
Shmuel: the Torah forbade only [the part of the nerve] that is on the kaf
כתנאי: אכלו ואין בו כזית חייב, רבי יהודה אומר עד שיהא בו כזית -- the baraita Rav Pappa quotes as the tannaitic dispute (svara stands in: no support kind for a baraita quoted after כתנאי)
Rav Pappa: [Shmuel's dictum] is [the subject of] a tannaitic dispute
the Rabbis' reason: it is a [distinct] creature

מכלל דשייר דרבנן לרבי יהודה; אלא דאורי ליה כמאן אורי ליה? -- if what he removed is the Torah-law part per R' Yehuda, what he left is rabbinic per R' Yehuda; then according to whom did his teacher instruct him? (unanswered: the text replaces the version with אלא)
Rav Sheshet: what bar Peyoli removed is the Torah-law [portion], according to R' Yehuda
bar Peyoli was standing before Shmuel removing [the nerve from] a thigh, and he was cutting it
he took fright, and the knife fell from his hand
Rav Sheshet (second version): what bar Peyoli removed is the Torah-law [portion], according to R' Meir
one who removes the sciatic nerve must remove all of it
one who eats an olive-bulk of the sciatic nerve incurs forty [lashes]
